protocol: Pre-registered paper scenarios. Definitions are frozen on the registration date; a changed idea gets a NEW name and starts from zero. Every scenario is logged every session, win or lose, in state/scenarios/ledger.csv (append-only, committed daily). 'base' is the primary system. Benchmarks and controls exist to show what luck looks like. Decisions follow decision_rule.
cost: 1.2 pips per unit of turnover for daily scenarios; 1.2 pips per round trip for the intraday control

weak_signals_sign.note: 14 signals, t-stat weights, sign position above median score

weak_signals_linear.note: 14 signals, ridge weights, linear position (best post-2016 variant, not the rule-selected one)

round1_combo.note: (FOMC eve + positioning sign + 2y-spread trend sign)/3 x vol scale

base_no_stop.note: does the disaster stop help or hurt

trend_3m.note: sign of 3-month return x vol scale; research says ~0

london_short.note: short 07:00-13:00 London every weekday; retired after round 2

agreement.note: position-trade form: hold only when positioning, 2y-spread trend and macro score agree (arm N: 59 % at 1 month, 61-72 % at 2-3 months, 2010-26)

agreement_wider.note: agreement rule only while the ECB-Fed policy gap is wider than six months earlier (arm S lead, family-wise p 0.11) | UPDATE 2026-11-11: failed replication on eight other currencies (arm V); prior is now 'probably chance'; kept running as a control

decision_rule.amended: 2026-11-11, before the first P&L session was logged, from the historical replay only (reports/scenario_replay.md, experiments/results/scenario_replay/rule_calibration.csv)
decision_rule.why: A scenario with true long-run Sharpe ~0.7 has a negative Sharpe in 32% of 120-session windows, 25% of 250-session windows and 9% of 500-session windows; a zero-edge benchmark in about 50%. Six months cannot separate skill from luck; it can only catch disasters.

gates.250 sessions (~1 year): DISPOSE if net Sharpe < -0.5; PROMOTE? possible from here (>= base + 0.3 and positive in both halves; owner decides)
gates.500 sessions (~2 years): DISPOSE if net Sharpe < 0; otherwise KEEP

decision_rule.primary: base is never auto-disposed; breaching a gate raises REVIEW
decision_rule.yardsticks: benchmarks and controls are never disposed
decision_rule.disposal: the scenario stops running; its ledger rows are kept forever
decision_rule.review: applied every Sunday by the weekly outlook
